description: Geology Faults is a dataset listed in British Columbia data catalogue (BC Data Catalogue), an open data portal, published or maintained by BC Geological Survey. Geology faults are part of the British Columbia Digital Geology, which is the data source used for the continuous province-wide, up-to-date, and detailed bedrock geology. The bedrock geology integrates all details of compilations from 1:50,000 to 1:250,000. Coverage: British Columbia. The portal files it under the publisher BC Geological Survey. Its tags are bedrock geology, digital geology, fault, geology faults. It offers 4 resource(s) in KML, MULTIPLE, SHP, WMS. The portal shows 2023-08-29 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence - British Columbia. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-bc-portal.
